Armaf CDNIM Pure Parfum — ₹4,900–₹6,545: Citrus/woody, formal and versatile. Nykaa currently lists ₹6,545; reviews report strong longevity, though batch performance varies. 
Nykaa

Lattafa Khamrah — ~₹3,960–₹4,785: Sweet, warm, luxurious; particularly suited to evening/winter weddings. 
Nykaa

Afnan 9PM — ₹4,840: Very sweet, powerful evening fragrance; reviewers commonly report strong projection and 7–8h longevity. 
Nykaa

Before paying: verify seller authenticity, batch/expiry, and the seller’s perfume return policy. Perfumes are often non-returnable once opened; cancellation terms can differ by seller.
